design_decisions.decision: The v2 frontier baseline binds accepted runs, integrated commits, merged PRs and closed blocker state for #75-#78; #79 starts at shared checkpoint 5af5c5c.
This is a ticket-only pre-guide review. Its sentinel revision/digest cannot satisfy guide review, guide approval, guide lock or acceptance.

Independent fixtures enumerate every public lookup, proposal/decision, execution and reconciliation row with status, exact recursive key/value allowlist, forbidden fields, state effects and provider counters.
SQLite independently owns one restart-stable success or closed target_not_found, validation_rejected or policy_rejected outcome per logical identity/fingerprint.
tested_subject_sha precedes an evidence-only publication commit, candidate Evaluation append and separate human-approval append; every descendant is selectively invalidated by changed scope.
Use KNORA_DATABASE_URL with sanitized effective 127.0.0.1/knora evidence, root invocation CWD and the worktree interpreter.
Final pytest evidence inventories every collected/pass/fail/skip/xfail node, classifies the three pre-existing PDF skips and forbids added or weakened non-pass coverage.
#79 produces only a non-binding final-review readiness checklist; the leader creates the real fixed-point descriptor only after #79 integration and closure.
The roadmap/release-ledger completion projection is part of the tested subject before guide execution; later mutation invalidates #79 acceptance.

invariants: The #79 native frontier is proven by immutable #75-#78 acceptance, integration, PR and closure identities.
Ticket review is not guide review or acceptance authority.
Authentication, path Workspace and resource authorization precede provider access.
Only a human ApprovalActor decides immutable proposals; exactly one concurrent CAS wins.
Every provider write requires current authority and exact compatibility.
One logical identity/fingerprint produces at most one provider effect across crash and restart.
Provider not-found and ambiguous observations remain non-terminal; stale owners remain fenced.
Evidence excludes credentials, raw routing, envelope bytes, key material and raw command output.
The starting baseline is non-green until the root-CWD Alembic defect is fixed without suppression.
Evidence-only descendants never silently change the tested subject or acceptance validity.
main remains pinned and the final code-review descriptor is not created by the worker.

test_cases.statement: Execute every independently defined ticket-lookup success/error row, including auth, Workspace, reference, scope, not-found, unavailable and malformed-provider variants.
test_cases.oracle: Each row matches literal HTTP status plus recursive body keys/values and forbidden fields; every denied row has zero provider lookup and only the authorized success/provider-result rows have the declared lookup count.

test_cases.statement: Execute independent proposal create/read/approve/reject, validation, not-found, forbidden-actor, already-decided, stale, expired and revision-conflict matrices plus concurrent human decisions.
test_cases.oracle: Every row matches literal status/body/state/audit/counter expectations; material fields never mutate, model/system has zero decision writes, and one human CAS winner persists.

test_cases.statement: Execute independent execution success, target_not_found, validation_rejected, policy_rejected, indeterminate, in-progress, fenced, idempotency-conflict, authority-denial and compatibility-stale rows.
test_cases.oracle: Every row matches literal public and durable matrices; denied/stale rows have zero admission/write/effect, valid execution keeps one server-owned identity/fingerprint and one effect.

test_cases.statement: Race direct execution and same/different-fingerprint replays across PostgreSQL admission and SQLite idempotency.
test_cases.oracle: One admission/current owner wins; same identity/fingerprint replays one outcome, different fingerprint conflicts and exactly one provider ticket/effect exists.

test_cases.statement: Across independent restarts, execute reconciliation rows for success; each closed target_not_found, validation_rejected and policy_rejected; unavailable; timeout; malformed; not-found; in-progress; and fenced outcomes in both crash windows.
test_cases.oracle: Each row is restart-stable and field-for-field exact. Rejections create no provider ticket/effect and finalize to their exact 502 result; committed success never duplicates; no-receipt/ambiguous rows remain non-terminal until separately authorized same-identity recovery.

test_cases.statement: Race current, foreign, strictly stale and changed-generation reconciliation owners using fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time.
test_cases.oracle: There is one takeover winner and one generation increment; current foreign remains in progress, stale/losing owners are fenced, and only the current unexpired owner records/finalizes.

test_cases.statement: Reconstruct append-only audit for all lookup, proposal, decision, admission, execution authority, crash, takeover/retry, observation and finalization paths.
test_cases.oracle: Ordered records contain caller/proposal/approval/execution actors, authority and immutable snapshots, generations, provider identity and outcome while a recursive leak scan is empty.

test_cases.statement: From repository root with KNORA_DATABASE_URL and pinned interpreter, run the known Alembic test and clean upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade.
test_cases.oracle: Focused test and lifecycle exit zero at head 20260824_0040; evidence binds effective sanitized DB, CWD and interpreter; no skip/xfail/weakening occurs.

test_cases.statement: At tested_subject_sha run focused M4, full repository pytest, Ruff and Compose, then generate the deterministic release artifact without tracked-content drift.
test_cases.oracle: All required nodes pass; counts and complete node inventories prove no added skip/xfail; the three pre-existing PDF skips are unchanged/classified; evidence binds exact subject, locked guide, environment and invocations.

test_cases.statement: Classify source-base-to-tested-subject and every later evidence descendant, verify the roadmap/release projection, main identity and final-review readiness template.
test_cases.oracle: No unapproved expansion exists; affected cases rerun; descendants are evidence-only or invalidate acceptance; main is unchanged and no actual fixed-point descriptor is created/pinned/validated/invoked.

test_cases.statement: Before execution verify human approval and digest lock of the exact guide, then append candidate and separate approval Evaluations to one history.
test_cases.oracle: Guide bytes/digest stay immutable; before/after history digests show append-only growth with unchanged prior records; candidate binds tested/evidence heads and pending approval; separate record names the exact PASSED run and explicit human approval.

command_projections.statement: Root-CWD Alembic regression and clean lifecycle with KNORA_DATABASE_URL, sanitized effective database identity and pinned interpreter.
Focused integrated M4 matrices and release harness at tested_subject_sha.
Complete repository pytest with node-level pass/fail/skip/xfail inventory and no new non-pass coverage.
Ruff, Compose and tracked-content identity verification.

required_evidence.statement: Immutable accepted-run, integration-commit, merged-PR and closed-state identities for #75-#78 plus exact 5af5c5c source base.
Independent literal public matrices for every lookup, proposal/decision, execution and reconciliation row with status/body/state/counters.
PostgreSQL one-winner decision/admission/takeover rows and stale-owner fencing.
Independent SQLite success and each closed rejection across both crash windows/restarts with logical lineage and exact effect counts.
Append-only audit reconstruction and recursive zero-leak scan.
Root-CWD Alembic repair and lifecycle evidence with KNORA_DATABASE_URL, sanitized effective DB, CWD, interpreter and exits.
tested_subject_sha verification plus full collected/pass/fail/skip/xfail node inventory, classified three PDF skips and zero new skip/xfail.
Evidence publication and Evaluation descendant graph with evidence-only diffs and selective-invalidation decisions.
Exact guide approval/digest lock and Evaluation-history before/after digests proving immutable prior records and separate human approval append.
Roadmap/release projection at tested subject, unchanged main proof and non-binding final-review readiness checklist with actual descriptor absent.
